title: 第二十一章残忍的祖训第二十二章各自的命运

老祖的神色慢慢的严肃起来，先前那份慈和仿佛被一层无形的寒霜覆盖，连周围的空气都仿佛凝固了几分。他目光如炬，缓缓扫过面前的两位后辈，沉声道：“翊儿，枫儿，你们且说说，一个家族的覆灭，最根本的症结，究竟在何处？”
此言一出，秦翊心中一凛，不敢怠慢，略一沉吟，拱手答道：“回老祖，孙儿以为，是……不团结。”
老祖没有立刻接话，只是微微颔首，目光却转向了一旁的秦枫。
秦枫眉头微皱，似乎也在认真思索，片刻后才道：“孙儿以为，是不公正。”
老祖闻言，嘴角勾起一抹意味难明的弧度，既像是赞同，又像是带着一丝深深的叹息道：“是，也不是。”
他缓缓站起身，负手而立，目光仿佛穿透了院内的虚空，望向了那遥远的岁月长河。
“‘堡垒最易从内部攻破’，此言不虚。”老祖的声音低沉而有力，“‘不患寡而患不均’，这说的是人性。不团结，是表象；不公正，是诱因。可追根究底，这一切的根源，都起于一个字——欲。”
他顿了顿，目光重新落回两人身上：“欲，本身并非洪水猛兽。若能善加引导，收束得当，便能化为推动家族兴盛、修为精进的磅礴之力；可若任其泛滥，不加节制，便会如决堤之水，冲垮一切秩序，引来百乱丛生。”
说到此处，老祖的眼神渐渐变得悠远而深邃，仿佛被某种沉重的回忆所牵引。庭院内一时间只剩下他略显沙哑的声音，在寂静中缓缓流淌，将一段尘封了五百年的往事，徐徐揭开一角。
“那是五百年前……”老祖的声音带着一丝沧桑，“那时，我已进阶元婴后期，修为初稳，正是意气风发之时。碧霄仙宗也借着这股势头，一跃成为修仙界的顶级宗门之一。大昭王朝在碧霄仙宗的鼎力扶持下，开疆拓土，南征北战，疆域不断扩张，最终一统东部仙土，成为名副其实的第一大仙土。”他的语气中带着一丝难以言喻的自豪，仿佛又看到了当年那金戈铁马、征战四方的景象。
“而那时的秦氏家族，族众已近三万，人才辈出，几乎完全掌控了大昭皇朝的朝堂与碧霄仙宗的宗门大权，可以说，整个东部仙域的兴衰，皆系于我秦氏一族一念之间。”
说到这里，老祖的声音忽然一沉，那股自豪被一种压抑的心痛与悲凉所取代。
“然而，盛极而衰，往往只在旦夕之间。就在一切都向好的方向发展时，旁支之中，却出了一个惊才绝艳的修行天才——秦不渡。”秦翊与秦枫皆是第一次听闻这个名字，不由得竖起了耳朵，屏住了呼吸。
“秦不渡此人，天资横溢，悟性奇佳。”老祖缓缓道，“他年仅二百岁便成功结婴，二百八十岁便已进阶元婴后期，其修行速度，即便是放眼仙土近千年历史，也足以排进前三。”
秦翊心中一惊，二百岁结婴，二百八十岁元婴后期，这等速度，简直是骇人听闻，比之仙史记载中的那些万古天骄也不遑多让。
“我见他天赋出众，又有几分当年我的影子，本有意将其培养为碧霄仙宗的下一任宗主，甚至……是整个秦氏家族未来的掌舵人。”老祖的声音带着一丝疲惫，“可我没有想到，他的眼界有缺，心性太差，欲望却强。”
“他等不及了。”老祖冷冷道，“他不愿循规蹈矩，按部就班地等待传承，而是急于上位，掌控一切。为了达到目的，他竟然暗中勾连外敌，以割让大片仙土为代价，联合了邓家、李家、秦氏内部的一些不安分的支脉，甚至还有海外岛国的矮人族，设下了陷阱。”
秦枫忍不住倒吸一口凉气：“他……他竟然背叛家族，背叛仙土，勾结异域？”
老祖眼底闪过一抹刺骨寒芒，声音如同万古寒冰道：“何止是简单的背叛……他选在东海琉璃岛，布下死局伏击于我。那一战，这天地间的强者，几乎尽数卷入，纷纷出手。我的师尊、师叔，还有同门师兄弟，无一幸免，全被拖入这场惨烈厮杀之中。”

“那一场大战，直杀得天昏地暗，日月无光。双方都死伤惨重，鲜血染红了整片东海。而我……若没有小师妹……没有蛟龙王念及昔日一丝旧情，悍然出手相助，恐怕今日，你们眼前早已没有什么老祖。”
“而我秦氏一脉，也早已在那场浩劫之中烟消云散，化作历史长河里，一粒无人知晓的尘埃。”
想到当年那惊心动魄的一幕，老祖的气息不由得一阵起伏，显然那一战给他留下的印象极为深刻。“那场背叛，秦不渡伏诛。”老祖缓缓道，“事后，我以雷霆手段，将参与此事的邓家、李家，以及秦氏内部所有牵涉其中的支脉，全数清剿。”
他的声音平静得可怕，听不出太多的情绪，却恰恰因此而更显森冷。
“也是从那时起，我亲手制定了族规一百条。”老祖沉声道，“这一百条族规，字字句句，皆由鲜血写成。凡触碰底线者，无论身份高低，修为深浅，杀无赦！”
秦翊与秦枫只觉得一股寒意从脊背升起，他们终于明白，族中那些看似严苛甚至不近人情的族规，背后竟隐藏着如此惨痛的往事。
“上次云鼎山脉之事……”老祖的目光再次变得锐利起来，“已经说明，又有人开始觊觎不属于自己的东西，开始试探家族的底线了。”
他看向两人，语气沉重：“翊儿，枫儿，你们要记住，人心之欲，是不可能被彻底消灭的。它如野草般顽强，只要有一点缝隙，便会疯狂滋长。人的欲望，更是无穷无尽，旧的满足了，新的便会立刻滋生。”
“我之所以对你们兄弟二人如此严格，是我对你兄弟二人寄以厚望，就是希望你们能明白这一点。”老祖的声音缓和了一些，带着一丝殷切的期望，“希望在今后漫长的人生道路上，你们兄弟俩能够始终背靠背，相互扶持，相互警醒，不被欲望吞噬，不被权力腐蚀。”
他顿了顿，继续道：“在我有生之年，我会尽我所能，将你们兄弟二人的修为，以稳而快的方式，尽可能推上元婴后期，为你们打下坚实的基础。宗门、家族的资源，也会逐步向你们倾斜。宗门、家族的管理，也会慢慢交到你们手中。”
“但修行之路，漫长而崎岖，充满了未知与凶险。”老祖的目光变得悠远，“我能护得了你们一时，却护不了你们一世。未来的路，终究要靠你们自己去走，未来的秦氏家族，也终究要靠你们兄弟二人去支撑。”
庭院内再次陷入寂静，只有老祖那沉重的话语，在秦翊与秦枫的心中久久回荡。他们知道，老祖今日所说的每一个字，都绝非危言耸听，而是用近千年的血与泪换来的教训。那一条条冰冷的祖训，看似残忍，却是秦氏家族能够在血雨腥风中屹立不倒的根基。而他们兄弟二人，从这一刻起，也真正意识到了自己肩上所承载的，是怎样一份沉甸甸的责任。

The ancestor's expression slowly became serious, and the previous kindness seemed to be covered by an invisible layer of frost, and even the surrounding air seemed to freeze a bit. His gaze was like a torch, and he slowly swept over the two juniors in front of him, and said in a deep voice: "Yier, Feng'er, please tell me, where is the most fundamental crux of the collapse of a family?"
As soon as these words came out, Qin Yi felt a chill in his heart. He didn't dare to be negligent. He pondered for a moment and answered with cupped hands: "Ancestor, my grandson thinks that it is... disunity."
The ancestor did not answer immediately. He just nodded slightly and turned his eyes to Qin Feng who was standing aside.
Qin Feng frowned slightly and seemed to be thinking seriously. After a moment, he said: "My grandson thinks it is unfair."
When the ancestor heard this, the corner of his mouth curved with an unclear meaning, which seemed to be both approval and a deep sigh: "Yes, and no."
He slowly stood up and stood with his hands behind his back. His eyes seemed to penetrate the void in the courtyard, looking towards the distant river of time.
"'Fortresses are most easily broken from within.' This statement is true." The ancestor's voice was low and powerful. "'Don't worry about scarcity, but worry about inequality.' This is about human nature. Disunity is the appearance; injustice is the inducement. But ultimately, the root of all this comes from one word - desire."
He paused and looked back at the two of them: "Desire itself is not a savage beast. If it can be properly guided and restrained properly, it can be turned into a majestic force that promotes the prosperity of the family and the advancement of cultivation. However, if it is allowed to overflow without restraint, it will be like a burst of water, destroying all order and causing chaos."
Speaking of this, the ancestor's eyes gradually became distant and deep, as if being pulled by some heavy memory. For a while, only his slightly hoarse voice was left in the courtyard, flowing slowly in the silence, slowly revealing a corner of a past that had been sealed in dust for five hundred years.
"That was five hundred years ago..." The ancestor's voice was full of vicissitudes. "At that time, I had advanced to the late stage of Nascent Soul, and my cultivation was initially stable. It was the time when I was in high spirits. The Bixiao Immortal Sect also took advantage of this momentum and became one of the top sects in the world of immortality. The Jozhao Dynasty was in the Bixiao Immortal Sect. With their strong support, they opened up new territories, fought in the north and south, and continued to expand their territories, eventually unifying the Eastern Immortal Land and becoming the veritable number one Immortal Land." There was a trace of indescribable pride in his tone, as if he had seen the scene of fighting in all directions.
"At that time, the Qin family had nearly 30,000 members and a large number of talents. It almost completely controlled the court of the Jokhang Dynasty and the power of the Bixiao Immortal Sect. It can be said that the rise and fall of the entire Eastern Immortal Territory is tied to the thoughts of my Qin family."
At this point, the ancestor's voice suddenly dropped, and the pride was replaced by a suppressed heartache and sadness.
"However, prosperity and decline often only happen overnight. Just when everything is developing in the right direction, an amazing and brilliant cultivation genius emerges from the side branch - Qin Budu." It was the first time for both Qin Yi and Qin Feng to hear this name, and they couldn't help but pricked up their ears and held their breath.
"Qin Budu is a man of great talent and extraordinary understanding." The ancestor said slowly, "He successfully gave birth to a baby at the age of only two hundred years old. He has already advanced to the late Nascent Soul stage at the age of two hundred and eighty. His cultivation speed is enough to rank among the top three even if we look at the history of the Immortal Land for nearly a thousand years."
Qin Yi was shocked. He gave birth to a baby at the age of 200 and the late Nascent Soul at the age of 280. This speed is simply shocking, and it is not far behind those eternal geniuses recorded in the immortal history.
"I saw that he had outstanding talent, and he had some shadow of me back then. I originally intended to train him to be the next head of the Bixiao Immortal Sect, and even... the future helmsman of the entire Qin family." The ancestor's voice was full of fatigue, "But I didn't expect that his vision was lacking, his character was too bad, but his desire was strong."
"He can't wait any longer." Ancestor said coldly, "He doesn't want to follow the rules.They follow the rules and wait for the inheritance step by step, but they are eager to get to the top and control everything. In order to achieve his goal, he secretly colluded with foreign enemies, and at the cost of ceding a large area of ​​fairy land, he united some restless branches within the Deng family, Li family, Qin family, and even the dwarves of overseas island countries to set a trap. "
Qin Feng couldn't help but take a breath: "He...he actually betrayed his family, betrayed the fairy land, and colluded with foreign lands? "
A biting cold light flashed in the ancestor's eyes, and his voice was like eternal ice as he said: "It's more than a simple betrayal... He chose Liuli Island in the East China Sea to lay a deadly trap to ambush me. In that battle, almost all the powerful men in the world were involved and took action one after another. My master, uncle, and brothers were all dragged into this brutal fight. "
“That great battle was so intense that the sky was dark and the earth was dark, and the sun and the moon lost all light. Both sides suffered heavy casualties, and blood stained the entire East China Sea red. And I...if it hadn't been for my junior sister...if it hadn't been for the Dragon King remembering his old feelings and brazenly helping me, I'm afraid there would be no ancestor in front of you today. "
"And my Qin family lineage has long since disappeared in that catastrophe, turning into a speck of dust that no one knows about in the long river of history. "
Thinking of the thrilling scene that year, the ancestor's breath couldn't help but fluctuate. It was obvious that that battle left a very deep impression on him. "That betrayal was punished by Qin Budu. "The ancestor said slowly, "Afterwards, I used thunderous means to wipe out the Deng family, Li family, and all the branches of the Qin family involved in this matter. "
His voice was terrifyingly calm, with not much emotion to be heard, but it was precisely because of this that it seemed even more cold.
“It was also from that time that I personally formulated a hundred clan rules. The ancestor said solemnly, "These hundred clan rules, every word and every word, are all written in blood." Anyone who touches the bottom line, regardless of status or cultivation level, will be killed without mercy! "
Qin Yi and Qin Feng felt a chill rising from their backs. They finally understood that behind the clan's seemingly harsh and even inhumane rules, there was such a painful past hidden behind them.
"What happened last time in the Yunding Mountains..." The ancestor's eyes became sharp again, "It has been shown that someone has begun to covet things that do not belong to them and has begun to test the family's bottom line. "
He looked at the two of them and said in a serious tone: "Yier, Feng'er, you must remember that the desires of the human heart cannot be completely eliminated. It is as tenacious as a weed, and will grow like crazy as long as there is a slight gap. Human desires are endless. Once the old ones are satisfied, new ones will immediately grow. "
"The reason why I am so strict with you two brothers is that I have high hopes for you two brothers, and I hope you can understand this. "The ancestor's voice softened a little, with a hint of ardent expectation, "I hope that in the long road of life in the future, you two brothers can always be back to back, support each other, alert each other, and not be swallowed up by desire or corrupted by power. "
He paused and continued: "In my lifetime, I will do my best to push the cultivation of the two of you brothers to the late Nascent Soul stage as much as possible in a steady and fast way, laying a solid foundation for you. The resources of the sect and family will gradually be tilted towards you. The management of the sect and family will gradually be handed over to you. "
“But the road to spiritual practice is long and rugged, full of unknowns and dangers. The ancestor's eyes became distant, "I can protect you for a while, but I can't protect you for the rest of your life." The future road will ultimately have to be walked by you, and the future Qin family will ultimately have to rely on you two brothers to support it. "
The courtyard fell into silence again, and only the ancestor's heavy words echoed in the hearts of Qin Yi and Qin Feng for a long time. They know that every word the ancestor said today is by no means alarmist, but a lesson gained with nearly a thousand years of blood and tears. That strip of iceLeng's ancestral precepts may seem cruel, but they are the foundation for the Qin family to stand firm in the bloody storm. From this moment on, the two brothers truly realized what a heavy responsibility they carried on their shoulders.
